desc:
Welcome to Moto Empire, the ultimate high-speed motorcycle simulator on Roblox!

🎃HALLOWEEN EVENT
Collect Golden Pumpkins around the map to earn prizes and unlock the Limited Edition Halloween 2026 Bike!

💸Use code: HALLOWEEN2026

Start with your first bike, explore a massive open world, earn cash, and build your way up to the fastest motorcycles in the game!

🏍️ Collect dozens of unique motorcycles
🔧 Upgrade your engine, exhaust, brakes, weight, and more
🏁 Race against friends and set new records
🔥 Perform huge wheelies
🌎 Explore highways, coastlines, cities, and hidden locations
📸 Experience realistic riding, rider movement, sounds, and first-person cameras
🏆 Become the fastest rider in Moto Uprising!

Will you build the perfect stunt bike, dominate every race, or collect the rarest motorcycles?

Moto Empire is still in development. If you find any bugs, please report them!
